newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Realty to offer 4.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Realty to offer 4.5 mln shares.

text.p: Healthcare Realty Trust Inc said Thursday it was commencing a public offering of 4,500,000 shares of common stock.
The company said underwriters are led by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; A.G. Edwards & Sons, Inc.; Equitable Securities Corporation; Lehman Brothers and Smith Barney, Inc.
All of the shares are being sold by the company.

The proceeds of the offering, estimated to be $123.75 million, will be used to repay outstanding indebtedness and to fund the company's acquisition and development activities, as well as for general corporate purposes, the company said.
